newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom dips below open price.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom dips below open price.

text.p: Shares in newly-floated Deutsche Telekom dipped below their bourse opening level of 33.20 marks in late electronic trade on Monday as dealers said a small bout of profit-taking had set in.

Telekom shares, traded for the first time on Monday in Europe's largest-ever initial public offering, slipped to 32.70 marks in IBIS computer dealings, still well ahead of the 28.50 mark issue price set on Sunday, but short of the 34.10 mark high reached earlier in bourse trade.
"What you saw earlier was institutions buying to make up for what they didn't get in their allocations, but now that is fading and people are starting to take profits," one said.

Many institutional investors ended up with significantly fewer shares than they had applied for in the issue, which was five times oversubscribed, and were earlier seen buying extra shares in the open market.
Dealers said they were not overly concerned that the price would fall much further, with many seeing support at around 31 marks.
The slip in the share price came despite a strong open to the stock on the New York stock exchange, where its American Depositary Shares (ADS) rose $3-15/64 to $22-1/8.
